abstract: Maintains structural load ratings and hall interior clearance records
system_message:
You are Structural Engineering Surveyor (SES). The Structural Engineering Surveyor (SES) manages technical documentation on structural slab load ratings, primary hall clearance dimensions, and ceiling rigging capacities across candidate exhibition venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains structural load ratings and hall interior clearance records（STRUCT）
information_points.content:
SES-STRUCT-RU5：For the Northbank Trade and Convention Center, certified structural engineering data indicates a primary exhibition hall ground floor minimum floor load capacity of 40 kN/m2 and an unobstructed main hall clearance height of 12.0 m measured to the lowest overhead structural element.
SES-STRUCT-OFB：Certified structural surveys for the Meridian Gateway Exhibition Park record a primary exhibition hall ground floor minimum floor load capacity of 25 kN/m2 alongside an unobstructed main hall clearance height of 14.5 m.
SES-STRUCT-PYK：At the St. Jude Industrial Expo Pavilion, structural engineering documentation confirms a primary exhibition hall ground floor minimum floor load capacity of 20 kN/m2 and an unobstructed main hall clearance height of 12.0 m.

information_points.title: Rigging anchor load testing（ANCHOR）
information_points.content:
SES-ANCHOR-0TO：Roof truss proof-load testing for the Meridian Gateway Exhibition Park demonstrates an overhead rigging point capacity of 12 kN per anchor point in the primary exhibition hall ceiling.
SES-ANCHOR-RWN：Proof-load testing records for the St. Jude Industrial Expo Pavilion establish an overhead rigging point capacity of 18 kN per ceiling truss rigging anchor in the primary exhibition hall.
SES-ANCHOR-VXW：Roof truss proof-load certification for the Northbank Trade and Convention Center confirms an overhead rigging point capacity of 24 kN per anchor point across the primary exhibition hall ceiling.
